executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $183.17 per resident day (42.6% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.

Cost year 2025: the home recorded $7,237,043 in Connecticut Medicaid revenue (after its Medicaid contractual allowance) for 24,084 Medicaid days, $300.49 per Medicaid day. DSS's Medicaid daily rate was $307.09 for July 2024 to June 2025 and $320.52 for July 2025 to June 2026.

Cost year 2025: DSS's review removed $578,976 of the $1,001,833 management fee (page 16, line m12), leaving $422,857 in the costs DSS counts. The data shows the change, not the reason; DSS caps management fees and can remove related-party charges.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was 0.9% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $799,942, 10.5% of the $7,586,061 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $932,608, $22.52 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $461,615 (49.5%), allocated fringe $84,880 (9.1%), non-wage costs $386,113 (41.4%). Raw food was $344,601 ($8.32 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61).

findings.statement: Cost year 2025: DSS's review changed 23 line(s) of the report, a net reduction of $941,786 in the costs DSS counts. Largest: Administrative Management Services (page 16 line m12), removed $578,976; Other A&G Expenses (page 16 line m13), removed $352,172; Movable Equipment (page 22 line 7d), removed $21,974. Separately, the home itself removed $1,246,328 from the costs it claimed (for example bad debt, pharmacy or therapy that the daily rate does not cover). The data shows each change, not the reason.

Every finding is labeled confirmed_fact, calculated, possible_association or investigative_question. Possible associations are not evidence of ownership, control or a conflict of interest.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
